static_traits.name: 陈楠
static_traits.family_status: 有支持性的家庭，但家人可能not完全理解其阿斯伯格带来的社交困难
static_traits.social_status: Has difficulty building relationships with colleagues in the new job and often feels isolated
static_traits.medical_history: 阿斯伯格综合征；No major physical illness；过去not yet接受针对社交困难的专门治疗
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly organized; tends toward literal understanding; easily overthinks others' intentions; tone somewhat negative but fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: 由于阿斯伯格，我倾向于把事情都按字面理解，在社交上有困难。最近我开始了一份新工作，今天同事们not怎么和我说话，这让我觉得他们看not起我。
basic_info.core_demands: The reason I seek counseling is that I have noticed social difficulties are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, especially in the new work environment.
growth_experiences: 在此前的工作环境中，因阿斯伯格导致的社交误解反复出现，常通过把注意力转向任务、Reduced socializing来应对，与同事关系建立受限。

core_beliefs: 我有根本性的缺陷/很奇怪

special_situations.event: One day after starting a new job, colleagues rarely talk with him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not主动和我说话，就说明他们看not起我/觉得I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becoming quiet, reducing interaction in order to avoid making mistakes, and closely observing others' behavior to work out social cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得I am a failure

special_situations.event: 同事开玩笑时他have not理解，其他人都笑了
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能及时接住玩笑或暗示，就会被认为很奇怪并被排斥
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overthinks conversation content; speaks cautiously to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am strange，他们会避开我

special_situations.event: 同事们彼此聊天而not与他互动，情境和他人行为较为模糊
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not明确的正向回应，就意味着他们not喜欢我或在背后议论我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 进一步Withdrawal、减少参与对话以降低被评价的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not喜欢我，可能会在背后谈论我

special_situations.event: 曾帮助同事完成项目并得到对方的感谢
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使偶尔有正向反馈，也not足以改变他人对我的整体看法
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或淡化积极经历的重要性，维持原有负性信念以避免期待落空
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那只是偶然，not代表他们会喜欢我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers and build stable, friendly interpersonal connections
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被嘲笑或被看not起，担心暴露缺陷后受羞辱
defense_goal: 通过保持安静和减少互动来避免出错
过度观察与Self-monitoring以控制社交风险
把注意力转向任务以回避情感性的接触

object_relations.self_representation: 格格not入、容易出错且被视为“怪异”的人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、评判并可能排斥自己的同事群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes challenging negative thoughts or suggests small behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为改变without效，do not人已经对自己下定负面评判（担心尝试只会带来更大失望）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹疑和低能量的语气表达怀疑，频繁use“可能/not一定/not什么用”，避免明确承诺改变。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes that positive experience of helping a colleague and being thanked
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将该经验视为偶然且not具代表性，以避免对关系改善抱有希望
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用客观、抽离的口吻强调“整体并not yet改变”“个例not代表总体”，回避探讨当时的积极情绪体验。

manifestations: Feeling isolated in the new job due to misreading social cues
Worries colleagues gossip behind one's back, thinking oneself a 'failure/very strange'
Reducing interaction to avoid mistakes, further deepening the distance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 在会谈与工作场景中过度在意他人看法

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在会谈中多次推测“他们看not起我/会在背后议论我”
将内在的自卑与Anxiety归因为他人的负面评价

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Knows one wants to connect with colleagues, yet holds back what one wants to say in interactions
选择沉默来避免可能的尴尬或出错
在会谈中对尝试新方法保持克制与Withdrawal

exception_events.target_problem: In social interactions at work, he usually becomes quiet and avoids conversation due to misreading cues, leading to more alienated relationships with colleagues
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once he took the initiative to help a colleague on a project and received thanks, experiencing a sense of being affirmed and connected at the time
exception_events.reason: 线索：采取了not同做法（主动在任务上提供帮助），并获得了同事的积极反馈与感谢，情境以任务为中心、规则明确，降低了社交歧义。

positive_force: Has task focus and competence, able to contribute value in task situations with clear rules
Has received positive feedback from colleagues in specific collaborations (being thanked)
Has a certain self-observation ability (able to notice one's tendency toward literal interpretation and misreading cues)
家庭提供情感支持（虽理解有限）
negative_force: Tends toward mind reading and hasty conclusions, amplifying potential negative evaluations from others
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation，易negate正向证据
Asperger's causes difficulty decoding implicit social cues
过度Self-monitoring与回避，减少实际互动机会，维持孤立

target_behavior.behavior: 在工作社交情境中Withdrawal、变得沉默
antecedent: 同事之间彼此聊天但not与其互动
同事行为或反馈模糊not清
遇到玩笑或隐含社交信号时not确定含义
target_behavior.core_reason: 因阿斯伯格对隐性社交线索解码困难，联结“Being rejected/被看not起”的核心担忧以灾难化方式放大风险，从而以Withdrawal来缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的尴尬与Being rejected，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 与同事关系进一步疏远，Loneliness与Anxiety intensified，工作表现受到影响

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently speculates about others' negative views (mind reading) and overthinks repeatedly
antecedent: 他人彼此交谈时忽略自己
含糊not清或缺乏正向信号的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值依赖外部评价且存在“I am a failure/很奇怪”的核心信念，促使其以读心方式解释模糊线索
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and avoid social risk by predicting others' thoughts
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety维持与升级，进一步回避互动，Reinforcement孤立与Self-denial
